schedule_description: KST Tuesday-Saturday after 07:30; verify the official U.S. exchange calendar on every run

deployment_gate.verification: Canonical source and installed Codex Skill normalized-content hashes must match after adding the finalized post-market automation route. Hashes use UTF-8 without BOM and LF line endings. Kiwoom remains session-aware guarded scoped Primary, yfinance remains diagnostic Shadow with the FSLY fallback, MVLL EMA10_RECLAIM_RVOL20 remains decision-class blocked, extended-session observations cannot become completed daily evidence, and only delivered POST_MARKET_FINALIZED runs may count. The strategy version and all existing trade thresholds remain unchanged. No fill, cash, quantity, leverage, short-sale, or order authority is added. The committed feature-state full suite remains mandatory before scheduled use.

SOXL.official_objective: 300% of the daily performance of the NYSE Semiconductor Index before fees and expenses

MVLL.official_objective: 200% of the daily percentage change of Marvell Technology common stock before fees and expenses

NBIL.official_objective: 200% of the daily percentage change of Nebius Group N.V. common stock before fees and expenses

soxl_max_loss_review.authority: user-approved maximum loss; alert engine calculates the exact boundary

mvll_max_loss_review.authority: user-approved maximum loss; alert engine calculates the exact boundary

nbis_max_loss_review.authority: user approved a 10 percent maximum-loss review boundary on 2026-08-12; no order or quantity authority

mvll_staged_reduction.authority: user instruction on 2026-08-05 to review, improve, and activate the proposed conditions; still no order authority

soxl_staged_timing.authority: user instruction on 2026-08-05 to review, improve, and activate the proposed conditions; still no order authority

nbil_de_minimis_manual_exit.authority: user explicitly stated the one-share position may be ignored or manually closed at any time

post_reduction_weakness_rearm.authority: explicit user request to require recovery above the related EMA after a confirmed reduction

SOXL.user_approval_reference: Explicit user instruction: SOXL maximum allowed loss is -20 percent.

MVLL.user_approval_reference: Explicit user instruction: MVLL maximum allowed loss is -60 percent.

NBIS.user_approval_reference: Explicit user instruction on 2026-08-12: NBIS maximum loss rate is -10 percent.

definitions.existing_position_technical_stop: max(prior 10-session low - 0.25 ATR14, 20EMA - 0.75 ATR14, exact hard maximum-loss boundary)
definitions.technical_stop_confirmation: one close at least 0.25 ATR14 below the dynamic stop, or two consecutive closes at or below the dynamic stop

SOXL.final_residual_policy: hard-risk review or later explicit user instruction only

new_buy_activation.earnings_blackout_single_stocks: 2 completed sessions before scheduled earnings through the first completed session after results

post_reduction_reentry_research.maximum_reentry_quantity: no more than the most recently confirmed reduced slot, and only after a separate approved risk budget
required_gates: explicit confirmed prior reduction fill record with tranche ID, session, trigger path, and quantity
position and confirmation proxy each close above 20EMA for two consecutive completed sessions
position and confirmation proxy each have 10EMA above 20EMA
both 20EMAs are rising under the active formula
no hard-risk freeze, excessive gap, explicit halt, stale quote, or unresolved corporate action
validated technical snapshot and independent same-session close cross-check
approved post-trade exposure and gross-leverage cap
user-approved initial stop, maximum-loss rule, and position-risk budget
post_reduction_reentry_research.quantity_cap_formula: min(last confirmed sold-slot shares, settled verified cash shares, approved risk-budget shares, approved portfolio gross-leverage-cap shares)
post_reduction_reentry_research.zero_cash_effect: diagnostic watch only; quantity must remain null
post_reduction_reentry_research.fill_policy: never infer sale proceeds, reentry fills, or restored shares
post_reduction_reentry_research.activation_gate: five-year stitched out-of-sample acceptance plus 3-to-6-month or 20-independent-signal forward shadow validation

gap_response.trigger: absolute opening gap exceeds max(5%, ATR14/prior close) or open gaps through the prior technical-stop level
gap_response.response: cancel stale candidate and require first-tradable-price human review; never infer a stop fill

halt_response.trigger: explicit halted, paused, or suspended provider status only
halt_response.response: freeze new entries and require a human review after trading resumes; never infer a fill

peak_drawdown.anchor_source: prospective completed closes after an explicitly approved activation anchor
peak_drawdown.draft_confirmation: fresh false-to-true peak-to-close breach while both holding and confirmation proxy close below EMA20
peak_drawdown.activation_gate: five-year stitched out-of-sample acceptance plus forward shadow validation

time_stop.draft_condition: MFE remains below 0.5 planned R and both holding and confirmation proxy close below EMA20
time_stop.applies_only_to: future explicit entries or reentries with a versioned planned R anchor
time_stop.activation_gate: five-year stitched out-of-sample acceptance plus forward shadow validation

dynamic_gross_leverage_cap.objective: maximize out-of-sample geometric return subject to approved drawdown, recovery-time, concentration, liquidity, gap-risk, and turnover constraints
dynamic_gross_leverage_cap.gross_effective_leverage_formula: 3*abs(SOXL market-value weight) + 2*abs(MVLL market-value weight) + 2*abs(NBIL market-value weight)

soxl_only_tier_map.0.75: SOXX close below SMA200 or aligned EMA downtrend
soxl_only_tier_map.2.25: SOXX close above rising SMA200 and EMA20, EMA10 above EMA20, and EMA20 rising
soxl_only_tier_map.3.00: 2.25 conditions plus SMA50 above SMA200 and SMA50 rising over five completed sessions

dynamic_gross_leverage_cap.tier_change_execution_assumption: next regular open only when tier changes and target capital-weight difference is at least 10 percentage points
dynamic_gross_leverage_cap.activation_gate: portfolio-level stitched out-of-sample maximum drawdown improvement of at least 5 percentage points and recovery-time improvement of at least 10 percent while retaining at least 90 percent of baseline CAGR, plus forward shadow validation

additional_indicator_filters.scope: entry and reentry filters only; never standalone exits
additional_indicator_filters.chaikin_role: low-priority research; never label as institutional accumulation
additional_indicator_filters.activation_gate: each candidate must independently pass the five-year stitched out-of-sample, cost-stress, fold, regime, and adjacent-parameter acceptance gate; then forward shadow validation

walk_forward_activation_gate.failure_reason: the available local SOXL and SOXX history cannot produce the required five-year multi-regime stitched out-of-sample test
safety_only_controls_exempt_from_return_: gap and halt watch-only fail-closed handling

requirements_before_actionable_buy: user-approved instrument and any leveraged ticker
user-approved entry rule or price band
user-approved position size or risk budget

alert_grades.A: next-session execution candidate; human approval still required
alert_grades.B: non-actionable watch or strategy-plan review; no order quantity may be inferred
alert_grades.D: hard holding-risk review; a maximum-loss boundary was reached or breached; no automatic order
alert_grades.F: critical data or state error; freeze every trade candidate

portfolio_exposure_policy.earnings_blackout_window_reading: starts at the second regular session before the announcement session; ends at the first regular session after results (before-open: the announcement session); any other timing is treated as after-close

K132-G.rule: 1.32 when gate on, 1.0 when shadow equity < 0.80 x 252-session shadow high; gate back on at >= 0.90

trend_confirmation.buy_rule: At least 3 of close>=MA20, MA20>=MA50, MA50 non-falling over 5 sessions, close>=MA200
trend_confirmation.sell_rule: close>=MA20 or RSI14>=55 while price is in the approved sale band

risk_pause.condition: SPYM and the active tactical satellite are both below their 10-month moving averages and both have negative 12-month absolute total returns
risk_pause.action: freeze later-stage buys and retain SGOV/brokerage cash
risk_pause.missing_active_satellite_policy: evaluate SPYM only and issue C review rather than D

funding_leg.trigger: only with a user-approved net basket
